description: SOS Kit: Codex hook payloads go to `sos hook codex`. The git pre-commit is the real gate.

hooks.command: sos hook codex pre-edit --protocol 1; rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 0 ] || { [ "$rc" = 2 ] || echo "BLOCKED: SOS Kit hook could not run (sos missing, too old, or failed: exit $rc). Install or upgrade sos: https://github.com/aspelldenny/sos-kit#quick-start" >&2; exit 2; }

sos hook codex pre-bash --protocol 1; rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 0 ] || { [ "$rc" = 2 ] || echo "BLOCKED: SOS Kit hook could not run (sos missing, too old, or failed: exit $rc). Install or upgrade sos: https://github.com/aspelldenny/sos-kit#quick-start" >&2; exit 2; }
